description_en: Detaches tags from one or more specified EAIS resources. When a tag is detached, it is automatically deleted if it is not attached to any other resources
description_zh: 为指定的EAIS资源列表统一解绑标签。解绑后，如果该标签没有绑定其他任何资源，会被自动删除
kebab_example: aliyun eais untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --resource-id eais-hzs4h26yyt5xkcke0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource is located. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. The only valid value is `instance`
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。目前取值仅支持`instance`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resources.

This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is not specified in the request.

Valid values:

true: Detaches all tags from the specified resources. If a resource has no tags, the operation is skipped and a success message is returned.

false (default): Does not perform any tag operation and returns a success message
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源上的所有标签。

当请求中未设置 TagKey.N 时，该参数才有效。

取值范围：

true：解绑目标资源的所有标签。没有标签的资源则不处理，直接返回成功。
false（默认值）：不执行标签操作，直接返回成功
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The tag keys. You can specify up to 20 tag keys
parameters.help_zh: 标签键列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag_key
